keySentence: Every minute counted — one missed connection could ruin everything.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: They saved Aouda! 🎉 She joined their journey. Doing the right thing is never a waste of time. Every minute counted — one missed connection could ruin everything.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Fogg and Passepartout successfully rescued Aouda from danger. She was incredibly grateful and joined them on their journey. They lost many hours, but Fogg did not regret his decision at all. Time can be made up, but a life can never be replaced. Every minute counted — one missed connection could ruin everything. Aouda's rescue proved that kindness matters more than any schedule.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: The rescue of Aouda was a complete success thanks to Passepartout's clever plan and Fogg's determination. Aouda was deeply moved by the bravery of these strangers who risked everything for her. She decided to travel with them since she had family in Hong Kong she could stay with. Although the rescue cost them nearly a full day, Fogg showed no sign of regret whatsoever. Every minute counted — one missed connection could ruin everything. However, this delay meant they would have to find creative ways to make up the lost time. Because Fogg chose compassion over his strict timetable, he gained something more valuable than hours. For the first time in his orderly life, Fogg experienced the warmth of genuine human connection.
